guide.summary: Single merchant, internal tool (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Public multi-merchant app via OAuth (app review).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Single merchant, internal tool (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Public multi-merchant app via OAuth (app review).

composio.note: Clover is in Composio's bring-your-own-OAuth-app list. Create an auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for Clover, so you must create a Clover app and supply its credentials to Composio.
reasons: Composio has no managed Clover app
Consent screen shows your app name instead of Composio

scenarios.label: Single merchant, internal tool
scenarios.when_this_applies: You control both the app and the one merchant environment, using a merchant-generated API token.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: Docs describe merchant tokens needing no app install or OAuth flow; no review is mentioned for this setup.

scenarios.approval: No Clover review is described for a single-merchant token setup.

scenarios.label: Public multi-merchant app via OAuth
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent serves many merchants, each authorizing your app through Clover OAuth and installing it from the App Market.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; includes identity documents, app details and videos

waiting.basis: Clover publishes no fixed approval timeline (c12). Document requests must be answered within 10 business days.

scenarios.approval: Clover must approve the production developer account (including an OFAC check), then reviews the app before merchants can install it.
extras: OFAC check repeats monthly after approval
Production developer account needed per country or region
Sandbox apps are not approved or published

prerequisites.title: Owner role on developer account
prerequisites.detail: Only an owner can edit Developer Info and accept the Developer Agreement.

prerequisites.title: Identity and business documents
prerequisites.detail: Expect to provide an EIN or Tax ID and address proof matching the application. A P.O. box is not valid for an individual's home address.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms
prerequisites.detail: A privacy policy and terms of service or EULA link is required and checked against Clover legal guidelines.

steps.title: Create global developer account and sandbox app
steps.detail: Create the account and build and test the app in the sandbox.

steps.title: Submit production developer account for approval
steps.detail: Enter identity and contact info in Developer Info and answer document requests within 10 business days.

steps.title: Wait for account approval
steps.detail: Clover verifies the account and runs an OFAC check.

steps.title: Configure REST app settings
steps.detail: Enable the REST Client, set the Site URL, and set Default OAuth Response to Code. The OAuth redirect_uri must exactly match the Site URL or an authorized redirect URL.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your Clover app ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into Clover.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and test connection works

steps.title: Prepare review materials
steps.detail: Draft the functional description, app details, benefits and a video script.

steps.title: Record video and submit for approval
steps.detail: Record the functional video, upload it, then click Submit for Approval.

steps.title: Wait for app approval
steps.detail: Clover reviews the app. If it takes long, contact Developer Relations.

traps.detail: The Clover OAuth 2.0 flow requires merchant authentication via the Clover login page, and this step cannot be bypassed.

traps.detail: OAuth access tokens expire in 30 minutes and must be refreshed with the refresh_token (stated generally, not specifically for testing mode).

Quote states merchants must uninstall and reinstall the app for updated permissions to take effect.
Quote states the 30-minute expiry but says nothing about refreshing with a refresh token.

Quotes say tokens avoid app installation and suit internal tools, but do not state that no provider review is needed.

Quotes state Clover must approve the developer account and app, and that apps are reviewed before listing for multi-merchant OAuth integrations.
Quotes say App Market submissions are reviewed, but do not explicitly say review is always required for every such setup.

Quote states the OFAC check repeats monthly after account approval.

Quote states sandbox apps are not approved or published.
